scope: Corrected hedgerow roots, 36 observations from nine cores, three zero root masses.
caveats: Residual test non-rejections do not establish model adequacy.
The mean of 2.613 simulated values below the added-response floor per 36 observations remains a physical-support mismatch; this frequency is not a calibrated hypothesis test.
The interaction is significant at 0.1, 0.5, 1 and 2 times the addition, but not at 10 times; do not retain an across-all-additions interaction-significance claim.
Sensitivity checks retain the selected Gamma model and do not establish independent field-level replication.
